title: Picou's name and his godfather
summary: Picou explains his godfather, who was an undertaker, and how Floreston and Piku became Alphonse.

story.theme_name: How I got my name: nicknames and band monikers
story.community_name: How I got my name: nicknames and band names

blocks.x: I got it from him last year.

My Godfather used to be a great undertaker on Ramport and... Well, this street here... Well, they changed the two names. No. Governor Nichols. Governor Nichols. But it wasn't Governor Nichols at that time. Hospital. Hospital. Okay, I guess it's going again. You were talking about your... Your Godfather that lived on the hospital street. Yeah. Yeah. And... He gave me his name. Floreston is my first name. R-Font is the second one. Piku, well that's the family. You see? But I changed that Floreston because I had so much trouble with Piku, you know? Yeah. For the pronunciation. So I said, well make it Alphonse. You see? Yeah.
